0022600003.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, and the Thunder are without Otega Oweh, who is out following Achilles surgery, while Chet Holmgren, Cason Wallace, Jaylin Williams, Nikola Topic, and Thomas Sorber are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The Spurs are missing Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). Oklahoma City has lost recent meetings with San Antonio, falling 1-4 in the 2025-26 season and 3-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 111-103 defeat in Oklahoma City on May 30, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Thunder a 45% chance to win.
